name: Nirvana
hook: A trio from a depressed logging town whose second album accidentally ended hair metal's run on American radio.
blurb: Kurt Cobain, Krist Novoselic and eventually drummer Dave Grohl formed Nirvana in Aberdeen, Washington, a struggling logging town. Their 1991 album 'Nevermind', led by 'Smells Like Teen Spirit', became an unexpected massive hit, and it knocked Michael Jackson's 'Dangerous' off number one in January 1992, one of the clearest documented turning points in American rock radio. It pushed the polished hair metal that had dominated rock radio out of fashion almost overnight. The quiet-verse, loud-chorus pattern Cobain borrowed from underground bands like Pixies reshaped mainstream rock for years afterward. The band's success quickly turned difficult for Cobain, who had been addicted to heroin for years, and he died by suicide in 1994.

signatureTracks.title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: The single that broke the album and, with it, mainstream rock radio's format almost overnight.

signatureTracks.title: The Man Who Sold the World
